node.title: All-admissible-row F2 extras-budget close
node.statement: Prove directly that non-coset-union F2 extras plus trade families are at most n^3=2^123 on every official prize-max admissible row. The July conditional close on growing-order Myerson is not valid at this scope: the 16-rung tower is inadmissible, and (O1) is false whenever ord_n(p)<[F_q:F_p]. The attempted all-row bounded-class reduction is also refuted by the generating row p=2^61-1, q=p^2. The plus branch reduces to explicit GRS kernels and the minus branch to one coupled negacyclic kernel. Generated-field ambient invariance now identifies every non-generating row's final block census and kernel mass exactly with one of three generating rows, so all 12 official degree/order types reduce to five signed generating types without restoring (O1). The remaining attack surface is common generating-row mass control, PP5.0 normalization, and any coset-sensitive Frobenius antipodal step used by a proposed proof. No consumer status is promoted.
